notes: Official Bosch datasheet (24813835275, en, V9, 14 Dec 2020), now hosted on Bosch's successor commercial-security/communications entity Keenfinity Group after Bosch divested that business in 2025; content and Bosch copyright are unchanged from the original manufacturer PDF. Confirmed via boschbuildingtechnologies.com asset catalog mirror as well. Part of the Bosch PRAESENSA public-address/voice-alarm system; DC-powered (no AC mains input — it is fed 44-60VDC from a separate PRAESENSA power supply/PSU unit, hence two DC input ports rather than an AC inlet). Each of the 4 amplifier channels also has a small dedicated "End-of-line device" screw terminal (rear panel) for connecting a supervision end-of-line resistor per loudspeaker line; omitted here as a separate port since it is a supervision tap on the same loudspeaker circuit rather than an independent signal path — noted for completeness. A rear-panel safety-ground stud is also present but has no matching connector type in the provided list, so it was omitted. All screw-terminal connectors ship as pluggable Euroblock-style blocks per the datasheet's "Parts included" (Set of screw connectors and cables). No HDMI/video connectors — this is an audio-only PA/VA amplifier.

ports.name: Lifeline Interface
ports.note: Combined pluggable screw terminal carrying the analog backup 'lifeline' audio input (0 dBV) plus control-interface signaling for the spare channel; counted as the unit's sole analog input.
